body.message: 4 months from August 23 works perfectly. The rate is AED 7,000/month all-inclusive, electricity, water, internet, no DEWA fees, and the only additional cost is a refundable AED 1,500 security deposit, no agency commission. First and last month are due upfront to secure the unit, with the rest billed monthly. Would you like to arrange a viewing before committing?
